planner: Gemini chooses bounded search phrases, facets and a user-stated area; the application owns SQL and joins.
activity_router: Existing BGE retrieval and Gemini selection still choose among 316 objectives. Warehouse retrieval does not change model weights or turn similarity into confidence.

domains.rule: Whitelist decision-useful sections, retain claimed versus inferred roles; never treat a topic as assessed competence.
A provider campus is not automatically the delivery location of every course. No invented travel distances.

joins: detailed occupation -> canonical group where required
domains.rule: Retain mapping method/strength and occupation-group scope. A career link does not grant qualification or licensing.
Stored course-sector tags remain labelled as mappings. Industry expansion must not overwhelm a selected-course question with unrelated occupations.

joins: user suburb/state or postcode -> unambiguous region
domains.rule: Do not choose ambiguous matches or infer user area from the institution. Parent-region fallback keeps the parent label.
Keep date, source, method and geographic scope. No national-to-local relabelling; no forecast guarantees.
Not a current vacancy feed, company-directory search, or evidence of an available job.

joins: provider RTO + national course code + delivery state
domains.rule: Retain period and conditions; provider entitlement is not personal eligibility. Missing remains unknown; zero remains zero.
Bounded candidates ranked with local BGE; user competence and eligibility remain unknown unless independently evidenced.
Unit codes are not assumed to be dim_skill IDs. A stored link does not prove assessment or provider delivery.

uses: dated examples near a user-stated area
domains.rule: PUBLIC active Australian records only; exclude expired records. Current availability is not confirmed. Keep geographic fallback and date explicit.

saved_interactions.course_choice: Existing versioned workspace correction; saved before model execution.
saved_interactions.area: Existing versioned workspace correction; retained on failure and available to next main-chat turn.
saved_interactions.scope: Conversation only; no warehouse or external profile writes.
saved_interactions.roles_and_skills: Server validates displayed IDs. HAVE is self-reported, LEARN is intention, UNSURE/missing is unknown. Save receipt before model execution; recall in next chat.
